ref_convention_notes: 64x64: dense Cholesky reference (pre-registered). 128x128: PCG tol 1e-8 as the pre-registered dense-equivalent reference. 24^3: the plan pre-registered a DENSE CHOLESKY reference at 24^3; the ~2 GB container cgroup makes the 24^3 dense Cholesky infeasible, so the executed 3D reference is a CONTAINER-FORCED DEVIATION to the PCG-1e-8 convention (PCG-1e-8 was pre-registered for 128x128 only, NOT for 24^3), recorded honestly and disclosed.
peak_rss_note: whole-run peak RSS (upper bound); the arm clock is arm-scoped

ref_attempts_log.provenance: execution-log detail (not a per-row measurement field): three earlier 24^3 dense-Cholesky reference attempts were OOM-killed by the ~2 GB cgroup before the final run adapted to the PCG-1e-8 convention; the count is disclosed as execution-log provenance only.
